notes.title: The Journey Begins: Digital Miners Trailer is Live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome Home, Miners! 👋[/h1]

We’re beyond excited to have you with us at this monumental moment—our Digital Miners [b]trailer[/b] is now live! 🎥✨ You can check it out on YouTube and right here on our Steam page. And guess what? Our [b]Steam page [/b]is fully up and running, ready for you to explore, even though we’re keeping the exact release date of the game under wraps for now.

But don’t worry, we’ve got you covered. We’re itching to share all the [b]latest updates, screenshots, and behind-the-scenes goodies[/b] from the development of Digital Miners. While some exclusive content will drop here on Steam, the best way to stay in the know is by joining our Digital Hunters community on Discord and following us on social media.

And once again, [u][b]Thank You[/b][/u] for being part of the Digital Miners family. 🙌 It’s your passion and the dedication of this incredible community that makes it possible for us to create such an awesome game.

So what are you waiting for? [u][b]Join the elite group[/b][/u] that’s about to change the gaming world:
